**Design decisions.** **DD-1 (one shared probe, no second round-trip).** `_recall_confidence_probe` does the single sovereign recall; `_recall_confidence_band` delegates to it (band-only view) so AD-981b's surface is unchanged. **DD-2 (gate = `remember_know_typing_enabled`, no new flag).** The same flag both populates `recall_type` at the store (AD-979f) AND opens the render gate → double-safe OFF. **DD-3 (own gap-safe note, do NOT reuse `remember_know_phrase`).** The shipped AD-979f `remember_know_phrase("know")` text contains "can't" and **trips** `is_capability_gap` (verified empirically in live code); the render layer therefore uses its own instructions-first note whose `remember`/`know` wordings were **empirically asserted** `is_capability_gap(note) is False`. **DD-4 (precedence — AD-981b wins on a weak/none band).** `_remember_know_segment` returns `None` when `observation["_recall_fok_band"] ∈ {weak, none}` (the AD-981b honest-absence cue takes precedence and AD-1038 suppresses "know"); when the band key is absent (AD-981b OFF) there is no cue to contradict, so "know" renders; "remember" only occurs on strong+grounded (AD-981b silent) so the two never collide. **DD-5 (render at both branches).** OFF ⇒ no `_recall_recall_type` key ⇒ segment `None` ⇒ no emit ⇒ byte-identical. **DD-6 (Tier-2 probe, fixed k).** Reads ONLY `self._runtime`, `k=5` literal, degrades to `None` on any missing subsystem/failure. **DD-7 (render/gate only — scope discipline).** No classifier/ranking/consensus change; the issue's Q3 "know"-down-weighting in consensus is **DEFERRED to AD-1039** (named, not built).

**Default-OFF / byte-identical-when-OFF (NON-NEGOTIABLE).** With `remember_know_typing_enabled=False` (default) the combined probe never sets `observation["_recall_recall_type"]` (and with both flags off the probe is never issued) → `_remember_know_segment` returns `None` at both render sites → no `_emit("remember_know", …)` → the prompt is byte-identical to pre-AD-1038. `config/system.yaml` is untouched (the default-OFF ships in `config.py`; AD-979f already added the flag). **Flip path:** set `remember_know_typing_enabled: true` under `memory:` in `config/system.yaml` and restart.

**Tests.** `+17 pytest` (`tests/test_ad1038_remember_know_render.py`, BF-287 discipline — a REAL `EpisodicMemory` on `tmp_path` with real ONNX MiniLM embeddings + the `_Holder`(`id`,`_runtime`) + `SimpleNamespace` runtime pattern from AD-981b; NO MagicMock at the store boundary): the `remember`/`know` notes contain the required markers AND are **empirically `is_capability_gap(note) is False`**; the shipped-`remember_know_phrase("know")`-trips-vs-render-note-is-safe contrast (documents DD-3); `none`/`""` notes are `""`; the segment renders a cue for `remember`/`know` and `None` for `none`/`""`/missing (the byte-identical-OFF render proof); **DD-4 precedence** (a `weak`/`none` band defers to AD-981b → `None`; a `strong` or absent band renders the cue); the live probe via a real runtime returns `strong`/`remember` for a grounded direct episode and `know` for an `anchors=None` episode (the round-trip preserves the non-grounded shape); the band delegator still returns `"strong"` (AD-981b regression guard); typing-OFF at the store yields `recall_type == ""` → segment `None`; the live `remember`/`know` confs compose into gap-safe cue segments; and two structural guards (`_build_user_message` renders `_remember_know_segment` at both episodic sites + `_emit("remember_know"`; `_recall_relevant_memories` gates `_recall_recall_type` on `remember_know_typing_enabled` via `_recall_confidence_probe`). **Gate:** focused (AD-1038 + AD-979f + AD-981b + AD-979a) **66 passed**; blast (AD-981a FoK logging + AD-979d slice-2) **19 passed**; `import probos.runtime` clean; `ast.parse(cognitive_agent.py)` clean. **Deviation (test harness, 1 extra file).** The STEP-1 delegator refactor + the STEP-3 call-site change mean the AD-981b `_Holder` stub must also expose `_recall_confidence_probe` (the band delegator now calls it) and the AD-981b structural guard must assert the new `_recall_confidence_probe` call-site symbol (the old `_recall_confidence_band` no longer appears in `_recall_relevant_memories`). `tests/test_ad981b_recall_confidence_gating.py` was therefore updated minimally/mechanically (the spec's DD-1 "keeps AD-981b tests green" assumption did not foresee these two obsolete-contract assertions); the AD-981b *production* helpers `_recall_confidence_note`/`_recall_confidence_segment` are **untouched**. STAGED (not committed).

### AD-981b: surface the agent's OWN Feeling-of-Knowing band into its response — an honest-absence cue for a weak/none name-cued recall (the "Heidi" misinformation case); default-OFF, byte-identical when OFF (#988, Oracle recall epic #902)

**Context.** Highest AD heading observed at authoring: **AD-1034** (the Composable-Cognition spine; **AD-981b is the number issue #988 carries** — the second live-wiring slice of AD-981, the recall live-wiring earmark, following AD-981a's observability slice). AD-981a made the AD-979a Feeling-of-Knowing band (strong/weak/none) **observable** on the live sovereign path (`recall_for_agent_with_confidence`), but the band still only ever reached the AD-979d slice-2 cross-agent escalation — it **never reached the agent's own answer**. The crew flagged the failure case ("Heidi"): a Captain asks a name-cued question — *"do you remember Heidi?"* — for which **nothing is recorded** (only "Grim" is in the shard). Because the BF-027 relaxed agent-return threshold (0.25) still surfaces the topically-distant "Grim" episode, `observation["recent_memories"]` is **non-empty**, so the existing empty-memories honest-absence flag (`_sensorium_no_memories_flag`, which fires only on a genuinely empty recall) **does not fire**. The agent then affirms the named memory and **invents provenance** for it — a textbook misinformation-effect confabulation. The AD-979a band for that query is **weak** (best owned similarity well under the confident-recall bar) or **none** — exactly the signal that should drive an honest "I have nothing recorded," but it was being thrown away on the own-response path.

**Decision.** Architect→Builder, contained to two files (`config.py` + `cognitive/cognitive_agent.py`). **No `episodic.py` change, no ranking change, no new recall mechanism** — the band is **reused** (it is already produced unconditionally inside `recall_for_agent_with_confidence`; AD-981a's `recall_fok_logging_enabled` gates only the *log line*, not the band), via one extra sovereign probe issued **only when the new flag is ON**. (1) `MemoryConfig.recall_confidence_gating_enabled=False` (inserted between `cross_agent_recall_enabled` and the AD-979e block). (2) Two **pure** helpers next to `_format_memory_section`: a `@staticmethod _recall_confidence_note(band)->str` returning a **gap-regex-safe** honest-absence cue for `weak`/`none` (and `""` for strong/empty), and `_recall_confidence_segment(observation)->list[str]|None` (the testable render-decision unit: reads `observation["_recall_fok_band"]`, returns `[note, ""]` or `None`). (3) An async probe `_recall_confidence_band(self, *, query, mem_id, k=5)->str` that reads **ONLY** `self._runtime`, calls `recall_for_agent_with_confidence(mem_id, query, k)`, returns `conf.band`, and is **Tier-2** (any missing subsystem or failure → `""`). (4) A flag-gated call site in `_recall_relevant_memories`, inserted immediately after the AD-979d slice-2 block (so `query`/`_mem_id` are in scope) and before the AD-986b transcript block, that stashes the band into `observation["_recall_fok_band"]`. (5) A render injection at **both** the DM and WR episodic sites in `_build_user_message`: `_fok_seg = self._recall_confidence_segment(observation); if _fok_seg: _emit("recall_confidence", _fok_seg)`.

**Root cause (the "Heidi" non-empty subtlety).** The bug is NOT an empty recall — it is a **non-empty-but-irrelevant** recall. The relaxed agent-return threshold surfaces *something*, so the empty-memories guard never trips, yet the FoK band over the agent's own candidates is weak/none. AD-981b reads that band and turns it into an explicit "RECALL CONFIDENCE: WEAK/NONE … you have nothing recorded … do not affirm a memory just because the question names it … do not invent a time, place, or detail" cue rendered right beside the (misleadingly non-empty) SHIP MEMORY block.

**Design decisions.** **DD-1 (reuse, don't recompute).** The probe calls the existing `recall_for_agent_with_confidence` — zero `episodic.py` change, zero ranking change; the band is the same accessibility-derived signal AD-979a/981a already compute. **DD-2 (default-OFF, Captain-calibrated).** The flag defaults `False` (Captain enables + validates against the Heidi regression; cue wording / band calibration may be tuned, per the AD-956 watch-then-calibrate discipline). **DD-3 (pure render-decision unit).** The note + segment are pure and independently unit-tested, separating the *render decision* from the async I/O probe. **DD-4 (gap-regex-safe cue).** The cue is checked against the decomposer `is_capability_gap` regex and must NOT read as a capability gap (else it would spuriously trigger self-mod and pollute the misinformation guard); the Architect's parenthetical "lacks the specifics" was rendered as "does not contain the specifics" because `lack(?:s|ing)?` trips `_CAPABILITY_GAP_RE` — "do not have" (with a space), "nothing recorded" and "no specific recollection" are safe (verified empirically via `is_capability_gap(note) is False`). **DD-5 (Tier-2 probe, fixed k).** `_recall_confidence_band` reads only `self._runtime`, degrades to `""` on any failure, and uses a `k=5` **literal** so it does not depend on `_tier_params` scoped to the BF-138 `try`. **DD-6 (render at both branches).** The cue renders at BOTH the DM and WR episodic sites; OFF ⇒ no `_recall_fok_band` key ⇒ segment `None` ⇒ no emit ⇒ byte-identical. **DD-7 (surface/gate only — scope discipline).** No band-compute change, no #987/AD-1038 remember/know render (no `recall_type` wiring), no proactive-path injection; the single known interaction is that enabling both `cross_agent_recall_enabled` and this flag issues 2 independent own-band probes per recall (acceptable; neither is default-on).

**Default-OFF / byte-identical-when-OFF (NON-NEGOTIABLE).** With `recall_confidence_gating_enabled=False` (default) the probe call site is skipped (`mem_cfg is not None and getattr(mem_cfg, "recall_confidence_gating_enabled", False)` is `False`) → no probe, `observation["_recall_fok_band"]` is never set → `_recall_confidence_segment` returns `None` at both render sites → no `_emit("recall_confidence", …)` → the prompt is byte-identical to pre-AD-981b. `config/system.yaml` is untouched (the default-OFF ships in `config.py`). **Flip path:** set `recall_confidence_gating_enabled: true` under `memory:` in `config/system.yaml` and restart.

**Tests.** `+13 pytest` (`tests/test_ad981b_recall_confidence_gating.py`, BF-287 discipline — a REAL `EpisodicMemory` on `tmp_path` with real ONNX MiniLM embeddings + the `_Holder`(`id`,`_runtime`) + `SimpleNamespace` runtime pattern from AD-979d slice-2; NO MagicMock at the store boundary): config default OFF; the weak/none notes contain the required markers AND are **not** `is_capability_gap`; strong/empty notes are `""`; the segment returns a cue for weak and `None` for strong / missing-band (the byte-identical-OFF render proof); **the Heidi regression** — `EpisodicMemory(relevance_threshold=0.99, recall_confidence_weak_floor=0.0)` seeded with only "My dog, Grim, is a giant schnauzer." (no Heidi), `recall_for_agent_with_confidence("yeoman", "do you remember anything about Heidi", 5)` yields band ∈ {weak, none} (empirically **weak**, best_sim≈0.061, count=1); that band composes into an honest-absence segment; the async probe returns `"weak"` via a real runtime and `""` for a missing-`episodic_memory` holder; a genuine strong recall (verbatim self-query) is unaffected and emits no cue; and two structural guards (`_build_user_message` renders the cue at both episodic sites; `_recall_relevant_memories` checks the flag before calling the probe). Blast-radius (AD-981a / AD-979d slice-2 + cross-agent / AD-979a / AD-979f / distribution / HXI chat — **103 passed**) green with the flag OFF; `import probos.runtime` clean. STAGED (not committed).

### AD-979e: self-healing reconsolidation — slice 1 (capture/persist an additive, capped, provenance-tagged recall access path; default-OFF, byte-identical, mechanism-only, no recall effect) (#907, Oracle recall epic #902)

**Context.** Highest AD heading observed at authoring: **AD-1034** (the Composable-Cognition spine; **AD-979e is the number issue #907 carries** — a sub of the Oracle recall epic #902, the reconsolidation follow-on the AD-979d slices explicitly deferred). When an old episode is reached via a query its *original* encoding never surfaced (the AD-979a/c slow-gap, healed by an AD-979d peer or an AD-979b expansion), a human's memory **reconsolidates** — the access path is written back so the *next* time the original phrasing hits the episode directly. This is the **highest-risk** capability in the recall frontier (it is the only one that can *edit* memory), so slice 1 is deliberately conservative: **capture/persist ONLY**, additive metadata, DIRECT-only, capped, provenance-tagged, default-OFF, with **NO recall READ** of what it stores (inert) and **NO canonical-content mutation**.

**Decision.** Architect→Builder, contained (`config.py` + `cognitive/episodic.py` + the one `__main__.py` boot site). **Three issue-text corrections verified against HEAD and heeded:** `recall_with_control`'s 3rd return element is `actions` (a band-tagged audit list), NOT expansion terms; the **AD-958d Hebbian access-path graph does not exist** (zero matches) — episode METADATA is the only additive surface, no Hebbian access edge; and there is **no callable AD-592 confabulation guard** (prose only) — poison-resistance here is structural (DIRECT-only whitelist + FIFO cap + de-dup + default-OFF), not a function call. (1) `MemoryConfig.reconsolidation_enabled=False` (inserted between `cross_agent_recall_enabled` and the AD-986b block). (2) `episodic.py`: module-level `_RECONSOL_MAX_PATHS=8` (per-episode FIFO cap) + pure `_normalize_access_terms(query)->list[str]` (lowercase, `[a-z0-9]{2,}` tokens, order-stable dedup — `fts_or_query` returns a MATCH *string* so it is not reusable for a `list[str]`); a defaulted `__init__` param `reconsolidation_enabled=False` → `self._reconsolidation_enabled`; and a new `async def record_recall_access_path(episode_id, *, query, bridge, source=MemorySource.DIRECT.value) -> bool` next to `update_episode_metadata`. The method's poison-resistance is **structural — every gate returns `False`**: **(1)** default-OFF (returns before any read/write → byte-identical); **(5)** DIRECT-only (refuse + log a non-DIRECT `source` — never re-encode an access path from a SECONDHAND/peer/reflection fragment); empty-terms; honest-degrade on a metadata read failure / unknown id / malformed `reconsol_access_paths_json` (→ `[]`); **(3)** de-dup (an identical normalized `sorted(terms)` is a no-op — repeat-poison resistance); append `{"q": sorted(terms), "bridge", "ts", "src"}`; **(2)** FIFO cap to the last `_RECONSOL_MAX_PATHS`; persist via `update_episode_metadata` (metadata-only — `self._collection.update(ids=…, metadatas=[merged])`, **no `documents=` → no re-embed**, so the **AD-541b write-once invariant** on document/embedding/user_input/reflection is preserved). `MemorySource` was **not** imported in `episodic.py` (the issue's verify-first claim was wrong) — added to the existing `from probos.types import …` line (the method default `source=MemorySource.DIRECT.value` requires it). (3) `__main__.py` threads `reconsolidation_enabled=config.memory.reconsolidation_enabled` at the canonical `EpisodicMemory` ctor (~:565); the rebuild-CLI ctor (~:1382) threads **no** AD-979x flag, so it is left unchanged (a defaulted-False param keeps it byte-identical).

**Default-OFF / byte-identical (NON-NEGOTIABLE).** With `reconsolidation_enabled=False` (default) `record_recall_access_path` returns `False` on the first gate — no metadata read, no write, no `reconsol_access_paths_json` key, canonical content untouched — and there is **no live caller** this slice (the method is mechanism-only; the live capture site is deferred to slice 2). `_metadata_to_episode` reads only known `.get()` keys, so the new metadata key is **ignored on read** (round-trip safe) even when present.

**Tests.** `+10 pytest` (`tests/test_ad979e_reconsolidation.py`, BF-287 discipline — a REAL `EpisodicMemory` on `tmp_path` with real ONNX MiniLM embeddings, a real `Episode(source="direct")`, metadata/documents read back through the real ChromaDB collection; NO MagicMock at the substrate boundary): default-OFF byte-identical (no key, `user_input` unchanged); ON additive write (one `q/bridge/ts/src` entry); **additive-only invariant** (post-write metadata == pre-write ∪ `{reconsol_access_paths_json}`, document byte-identical, `user_input`/`reflection`/`timestamp`/`importance`/`content_hash`/`source` identical); **AD-541b intact** (a second `store()` of the same id is still skipped, the path write went through metadata-only); per-episode FIFO cap (`_RECONSOL_MAX_PATHS+3` distinct queries → length 8, oldest evicted, newest retained); de-dup repeat-poison (same query ×5 + a re-ordered variant → length 1); DIRECT-only (SECONDHAND and REFLECTION both refused, no metadata); provenance present + normalized `q`; unknown-id honest-degrade (`False`, no crash); empty/no-token query refused. Blast-radius (AD-979a / AD-979d slice 1+2 / AD-981a / dreaming / distribution = 108 passed) green with the flag OFF; `import probos.runtime` clean.

**Deferred slices (the heal is NOT in slice 1):** **slice 2** = wire the capture at the live gap-bridge moment (when an AD-979b expansion or AD-979d peer actually resolves a weak band); **slice 3** = the recall READ that makes the original query hit the episode directly (the actual "heal" — where an integrity/consensus gate on *using* a reconsolidated path is decided); **slice 4** = an offline dreaming bulk pass that reconsolidates access paths during idle.

### AD-979d: distributed cross-agent associative recall — slice 2 (live-wire the `CrossAgentRecallService` into the sovereign recall path; fires on a weak own FOK band, renders the peer's confident recall as `[secondhand]`), default-OFF, byte-identical when OFF (#906, Oracle recall epic #902)

**Context.** Highest AD heading observed at authoring: **AD-1034** (the Composable-Cognition spine; **AD-979d is the number issue #906 carries** — a sub of the Oracle recall epic #902). Slice 1 shipped the `CrossAgentRecallService` mechanism but with **no live caller** — the weak Feeling-of-Knowing band was surfaced (AD-981a) but still never *acted on* in the live recall path. Slice 2 makes #906 **LIVE**: it wires the service into `CognitiveAgent._recall_relevant_memories` so that, when an agent's own sovereign recall returns a **weak** band (the AD-979a/c slow-gap — relevant-but-under-the-bar, not strong recall and not genuine absence), the query escalates to the single most-associated crew peer and that peer's **confident** recall is surfaced as `SECONDHAND` memory.

**Decision.** Architect→Builder, contained to ONE file (`cognitive/cognitive_agent.py`): a new helper `_maybe_cross_agent_recall(self, *, query, mem_id, k=3) -> list[dict]` (reads ONLY `self.id` + `self._runtime`) + one flag-gated call-site block. No change to `CrossAgentRecallService`, `EpisodicMemory`, or `RecallConfidence`. The helper is **Tier-2 throughout** — every gate/failure returns `[]`: runtime / `mem_cfg` / flag / service / `episodic_memory` / `registry` / `hebbian_router` None-checks; a bounded crew roster (`is_crew_agent`, self-excluded, capped 32); the own-band probe `recall_for_agent_with_confidence(mem_id, query, k)` gated to `band == "weak"` **only** (a strong own recall needs no help; a `none` absence must not be papered over with a peer's guess); Hebbian top-1 by `get_weight(self.id, peer.id, REL_SOCIAL)` requiring `> 0.0` (only ask a real colleague); then `escalate_recall(...)`; the returned `PeerRecall`s map to memory dicts (`{"input": f"{callsign} recalls: …", "reflection", "source", "verified": False}` + optional anchors) appended to `observation["recent_memories"]`.

**ID-space resolution (the load-bearing finding).** `REL_SOCIAL` Hebbian edges key on the **live** `agent.id`; episodic shards key on `sovereign_id or id` — the two **diverge for onboarded crew**. Neither the service nor `EpisodicMemory` is changed. The seam is resolved **at the call site**: rank crew peers by `get_weight(self.id, peer.id, REL_SOCIAL)` (live-id space), pick top-1, then pass the service a **singleton** `peer_candidates=[top.sovereign_id or top.id]` (shard space). Because `get_preferred_targets` over a 1-element list returns it unconditionally (it ranks but does not *filter* zero-weight candidates), the service's internal ranking is an **identity** and the real selection happens in live space. `requesting_agent_id = mem_id` (shard space) drives the service's self-exclusion + own-shard governance.

**Default-OFF / byte-identical-when-OFF (NON-NEGOTIABLE).** The call-site block is `if mem_cfg is not None and getattr(mem_cfg, "cross_agent_recall_enabled", False):` (the existing slice-1 flag, default `False`) — when OFF the block is skipped entirely: no helper call, no extra recall query, `observation` untouched ⇒ byte-identical to pre-slice-2. `mem_cfg` is re-fetched defensively immediately before the guard (it is assigned inside the BF-138 `try` above; an early exception there could otherwise leave it unbound and turn the OFF guard into a `NameError`) — mirroring the AD-986b transcript block right below. The extra `recall_for_agent_with_confidence` own-band probe is issued ONLY when ON.

**Verified render adjustment (Python 3.12).** The new memory dicts carry `"source": MemorySource.SECONDHAND.value` (the **string** `"secondhand"`), not the bare enum: `Episode.source` is a `str` field and the existing recall path already puts a string into `mem["source"]`, so `_format_memory_section`'s `f"[{source} | …]"` renders `[secondhand | unverified]`. Under Python 3.12's enum `__format__` change `f"{MemorySource.SECONDHAND}"` renders as the repr `MemorySource.SECONDHAND` (verified empirically), which would break the marker; `.value` is byte-consistent with every other `recent_memories` entry and still satisfies `mem["source"] == MemorySource.SECONDHAND` (str equality).

**Tests.** `+9 pytest` (`tests/test_ad979d_slice2_live_wiring.py`, BF-287 discipline — real `EpisodicMemory` on `tmp_path` with `relevance_threshold=0.99` + `recall_confidence_weak_floor=0.0` for a deterministic weak band, real `HebbianRouter` social edge via `record_interaction(…, REL_SOCIAL)`, real `TrustNetwork`, real `CrossAgentRecallService`; the requester is a tiny `_Holder(id, _runtime)` stub, NOT MagicMock): config default OFF; helper OFF ⇒ `[]` (even with a strong corroborating peer + positive edge); **structural** byte-identical-OFF (the literal flag guard precedes the helper call in `_recall_relevant_memories`'s source); weak fires + `[secondhand | unverified]` render; strong / none own band ⇒ `[]`; no social edge ⇒ `[]`; service None ⇒ `[]`; most-associated peer chosen (two strong peers, only A→B edge → B's callsign). Slice-1 (`+10`) + blast-radius (AD-979a/c/f, AD-981a, distribution, HXI chat — 100 passed) green; `import probos.runtime` clean.

**This makes #906 LIVE** — single-peer, fires on a weak FOK band when enabled. Still deferred (#907): multi-peer fan-out / fusion + trust-**weighting**, IntentBus transport + per-domain rate limiter (out-of-process peers), reconsolidation / storing the peer's memory into the requester's own shard.

### AD-979d: distributed cross-agent associative recall — slice 1 (CrossAgentRecallService: FOK-gated + Hebbian top-1 + in-process governed shard-swap + SECONDHAND provenance), default-OFF, byte-identical (#906, Oracle recall epic #902)

**Context.** Highest AD heading observed at authoring: **AD-1034** (the Composable-Cognition spine; **AD-979d is the number issue #906 carries** — a sub of the Oracle recall epic #902, sibling to AD-979a/b/c/f). When an agent's own sovereign recall returns a **weak** Feeling-of-Knowing band — the AD-979a/c *slow-gap* (something relevant is present but under the confident-recall bar; a vocabulary-mismatch miss), not a strong recall and not a genuine absence — a human asks a colleague who was there. Nothing in ProbOS does this: the weak band was surfaced (AD-981a) but never *acted on* across agents. **Honest decomposition (the load-bearing finding):** the existing `SocialMemoryService` (AD-462d) is **Ward-Room BROADCAST only** (async fan-out, no directed single-peer path) so it is NOT reusable for a directed associative query; and ProbOS stores every agent's episodes in **ONE shared collection** sharded by `agent_ids` metadata, so a "peer query" is just `recall_for_agent_with_confidence(peer_id, …)` on that same store — **no IntentBus transport and no rate limiter are needed** (those are only for out-of-process peers). So slice 1 ships the **mechanism/service half ONLY**.

**Decision.** Architect→Builder, contained to a NEW standalone `cognitive/cross_agent_recall.py` + a config flag + a construction-only runtime block (the three consumed subsystems — `EpisodicMemory`, `HebbianRouter`, `TrustNetwork` — and `RecallConfidence` are consumed **UNCHANGED**). `CrossAgentRecallService` is constructor-injected (Dependency Inversion: episodic store + Hebbian router + optional trust network; the peer set is *passed in* per call — it never imports the registry or reaches into the runtime). Its one method `escalate_recall(requesting_agent_id, query, own_band, *, peer_candidates, callsigns=None, k=3)` is a 9-gate pipeline where **every guard returns `[]`** (the no-op / honest-degrade path): **(1)** OFF gate (`enabled=False` default → return before touching any dependency → **byte-identical**); **(2)** governance — refuse under `OWN_SHARD_ONLY` (AD-607e); **(3)** FOK gate — escalate **only** on `own_band == "weak"` (`own_band` is the requester's *already-computed* band, supplied directly — a strong band needs no help; a `none` absence must not be papered over with a peer's guess); **(4)** exclude self from `peer_candidates`; **(5)** Hebbian **top-1** — `get_preferred_targets(requester, peers, rel_type=REL_SOCIAL)[0]`, the single most-associated peer; **(6)** Tier-2 around `recall_for_agent_with_confidence(peer_id, query, k)` → log-and-degrade to `[]`; **(7)** surface **only** the peer's `strong` band (never a confabulated corroboration from a peer that is itself guessing); **(8)** attach the peer's **raw** Beta `(alpha, beta)` from `TrustNetwork.get_record` — never a derived mean, and **not** used to weight or rank (repo rule); **(9)** build bounded `PeerRecall` items carrying `MemorySource.SECONDHAND` (AD-541) + the peer callsign. Config: `MemoryConfig.cross_agent_recall_enabled = False` (default OFF → `escalate_recall()` returns `[]` → byte-identical). Runtime: a construction-only block mirroring the AD-462d `SocialMemoryService` late-bind (`self._cross_agent_recall_service`), guarded on `episodic_memory` + `hebbian_router`, **no hot-path call** in slice 1. **Byte-identical-OFF proof:** with the flag OFF the service is never enabled, and even when constructed `escalate_recall` returns `[]` at gate 1 before any dependency is touched — the AD-979a/b/c, routing, and config suites all stay green (58 passed). **+10 pytest** (`tests/test_ad979d_cross_agent_recall.py`, BF-287 discipline — real `EpisodicMemory` on `tmp_path` with real MiniLM embeddings, real in-memory `HebbianRouter` (weights set via `record_interaction(…, rel_type=REL_SOCIAL)`), real `TrustNetwork` (record via `record_outcome`); NO MagicMock at those boundaries; two sovereign shards seeded via the real store-with-`agent_ids` path).

**Slice 1 = service/mechanism ONLY. Deferred follow-ons (explicitly NOT in this slice):** live `cognitive_agent.py` recall-path wiring (the live site is multi-tier and does not surface the FOK band → needs a restructure, not a byte-identical edit); IntentBus transport + per-domain rate limiter (only for out-of-process peers); multi-peer fan-out + trust-**weighted** fusion (slice 1 attaches raw `alpha`/`beta` only); reconsolidation / storing the peer's memory back into the requester's own shard (#907). A known scope note: issue #906's acceptance text mentions "real IntentBus" — slice 1 is deliberately in-process, justified by the single shared collection.

### AD-979f: remember/know recall typing (A) + affective-salience rerank slot/axis (B3) — default-OFF, byte-identical when OFF (#908, Oracle recall epic #902)

**Context.** Highest AD heading observed at authoring: **AD-1034** (the Composable-Cognition spine; **AD-979f is the number issue #908 carries** — a sub of the Oracle recall epic #902, built alongside AD-988). Two cognitive-science recall refinements, both contained to the episodic tier and both OFF by default (the Captain's non-disruptive mandate). **(A) Remember/Know typing** (Tulving 1985): the AD-979a `RecallConfidence` carries a band (strong/weak/none) but no *type* — the distinction between *re-experiencing* an episode ("remember") and bare *familiarity* ("know"). **(B) Affective salience** (emotionally salient memories are preferentially retrieved): the AD-873 composite reranker scores strength/recency/importance/confidence but has no affect axis. **Honest decomposition (the load-bearing finding): affect is NOT stored on `Episode` and NOT readable at the rerank site today** — there is no measured-affect capture pipeline. So B ships the **mechanism + storage slot ONLY** and DEFERS the capture to a follow-on AD; this is **B3 (axis + slot), not measured affect**. **Decision.** Architect→Builder, contained (`types.py` + `cognitive/episodic.py` + a config flag + a weight + the one `__main__.py` boot wiring). **(A)** `RecallConfidence` gains `recall_type: str = ""` (default `""` = typing OFF, byte-identical). Two **pure** module-level helpers next to `classify_recall_confidence`: `classify_remember_know(band, top_episode)` — `"remember"` iff `band=="strong"` AND the top episode has episodic grounding (a populated `AnchorFrame` with `channel`/`participants`/`trigger_agent`/`source_timestamp`) AND `source != "reflection"`; `"know"` for strong/weak-without-grounding or a reflection synthesis; `"none"` for an empty band/episode — and `remember_know_phrase(recall_type)` (a pure formatter; the live agent-wording render is a DEFERRED follow-on). Gated by a new `MemoryConfig.remember_know_typing_enabled=False` threaded into `EpisodicMemory.__init__` and attached at BOTH confidence sites (`recall_with_confidence`, `recall_for_agent_with_confidence`) via `dataclasses.replace` — OFF ⇒ no replace ⇒ `recall_type` stays `""` ⇒ byte-identical; the early-return (empty-store / empty-query) paths are intentionally untouched. **(B3)** `Episode` gains a LAST field `affect_salience: float = 0.0` (frozen-safe, all-defaulted) that round-trips through ChromaDB (`_episode_to_metadata` write + `_metadata_to_episode` decode with a `(TypeError, ValueError)`→`0.0` honest-degrade; pre-979f episodes lacking the key → `0.0`). `_composite_recall_score` gains, after the confidence term, `w_a = float(weights.get("affect", 0.0)); if w_a: score *= _clamp01(episode.affect_salience) ** w_a` — and `recall_rerank_weights` gains `"affect": 0.0`. **Default weight 0.0 ⇒ the term is skipped (`x**0==1` idiom, identical to absence) ⇒ byte-identical**; what POPULATES `affect_salience` is a DEFERRED capture AD (no capture pipeline ships here). **Byte-identical-OFF proof:** the AD-873 suite (composite score with affect absent / weight 0.0) and the AD-979a suite (`RecallConfidence` default `recall_type==""`) both stay green; the empty-store typing-ON path stays `""`. **+23 pytest** (`tests/test_ad979f_remember_know_affect.py`, real `Episode`/`RecallConfidence`/`MemoryConfig`/`EpisodicMemory` on `tmp_path`, BF-287 discipline — no MagicMock). **Deferred follow-ons:** the affect-capture pipeline (what writes `affect_salience`), the live agent-wording render of `recall_type` (only the pure `remember_know_phrase` ships here), #906 cross-agent recall, and #907 reconsolidation.

### AD-988: retrieval-reason transparency — surface *why* an episodic fragment was retrieved; default-OFF, byte-identical when OFF (#932, Oracle recall epic #902)

**Context.** Highest AD heading observed at authoring: **AD-1034** (the Composable-Cognition spine; **AD-988 is the number issue #932 carries** — a forward-marker filed during the AD-986a/987 wave, built now). The episodic tier computes a full `RecallScore` breakdown (`semantic_similarity / keyword_hits / trust_weight / hebbian_weight / recency_weight / anchor_confidence / tcm_similarity`) and the Oracle **collapses it to one scalar** (`rs.composite_score`) at the `OracleResult` projection — so the agent sees a score but not the dominant signal. The Counselor's 2026-06-13 recall feedback named the gap exactly: *"I can tell it's reaching, but I can't always tell why it's reaching."* This is the **third instance this arc of *rich scoring computed then discarded at the prompt boundary*** — after AD-979a (the FoK "invisible miss": per-candidate similarity computed then thrown away) and BF-625 (ranking collapsed to a raw token-overlap sum). **Decision.** Architect→Builder, contained (oracle_service.py + types.py + a config flag + the one construction-site wiring). (1) `OracleResult` gains `match_reason: str = ""` — additive/defaulted, so the other ~8 construction sites (records/operational/archive/semantic/graph/health/expansion) are unaffected and keep `match_reason==""` (no regression). (2) New **pure** `dominant_match_reason(rs: RecallScore) -> str` in `types.py` (next to `RecallScore`; no I/O, deterministic, unit-testable): `keyword_hits > 0` ⇒ `"keyword match (<n> hit[s])"` (lexical/FTS5 is the strongest *explicit* signal — wins outright); else the MAX of the normalized `[0,1]` graded signals named with its value (`"semantic similarity (0.83)"` / `"Hebbian co-activation"` / `"anchored context"` / `"recency"` / `"temporal context"`, ties → first in that order); `trust_weight` is **excluded** (a weighting, not a match reason); all-zero ⇒ `"weak/ambiguous match"` (the degenerate "it's reaching" case). (3) The **gate** is a default-OFF `MemoryConfig.oracle_match_reason_enabled: bool = False` read at the OracleService construction site (`startup/cognitive_services.py`, defensive `getattr(config.memory, …, False)`) into `self._match_reason_enabled` (OracleService has no config handle, so the bool is threaded via a defaulted `__init__` param — every existing `OracleService(...)` is unchanged). (4) The **episodic projection site** (`_query_episodic`, the `recall_weighted` branch — the only site where `rs` is in scope) sets `match_reason=dominant_match_reason(rs)` when ON, `""` when OFF; the `recall()` fallback site (`score=0.5`, no `RecallScore`) stays `""`. (5) `query_formatted` appends `, why: {match_reason}` before the closing paren **only** when the gate is ON and the result carries a reason — OFF (default) or empty ⇒ rendering byte-identical to pre-AD-988. **Byte-identical proof:** with the flag OFF every `OracleResult.match_reason==""` and `query_formatted` output is byte-for-byte identical (asserted against an exact expected string on a representative episodic result, and cross-checked as ON-minus-the-why-clause == OFF). Closes the 3rd instance of the compute-then-discard-at-the-prompt-boundary pattern (after AD-979a, BF-625) — candidate architecture-review flag. **Deferred (per the #932 design):** the other 6 tiers' per-tier reason strings (records/operational/graph/health/semantic/archive each derive score differently) — this wave does only the episodic tier (where the breakdown already exists); and "match terms" extraction (`keyword_hits` is a count, not the terms — `"keyword match (N hits)"` suffices for v1). **Gates.** New `test_ad988_retrieval_reason.py` (21, BF-287 real `RecallScore`/`OracleResult`/`MemoryConfig`/`OracleService`/`Episode`; no MagicMock at these boundaries): the pure heuristic across keyword/semantic/hebbian/anchor/recency/tcm/all-zero/trust-excluded/tie cases, episodic carries the reason ON / `""` OFF, the unscored-fallback stays `""`, `query_formatted` byte-identical OFF and surfaces the reason ON, non-episodic (records) result stays `""` with the flag ON, and the config default is False. Regression: `test_ad462f_memory_refs` (the `OracleResult`/`OracleService` MemoryRef projection — most directly affected by the new field) + the oracle-tier suites (`test_ad686`/`686b`/`688`/`695`/`696`) + `test_distribution` = **105 passed** (pre-existing importlib_metadata DeprecationWarning only); `import probos.runtime` smoke ok. NO change to existing `RecallScore`/`OracleResult` fields or the `query_formatted` signature; NO change to composite scoring / recall ranking / other tiers' scoring; `config/system.yaml` untouched. Staged for review, not committed. Verify all changes comply with the Engineering Principles in `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

### AD-1036 — live exogenous @mention arousal (mention pilot) (epic #983)

**Context.** Current highest landed top-level = **AD-1052**; **AD-1036 is a pre-reserved Composable-Cognition sub-number** (epic #983's attention/composition cluster, AD-1029→AD-1036) — it is **NOT a new top-level number**, it is the final slice of that reserved cluster (#985). AD-1032 built the `AttentionFaculty` arousal model (the severity table `mention→AMBER`, the faculty-local GREEN→AMBER→RED zone, `on_exogenous_event` as the single governed boundary) but **deliberately wired NO live source** — the router @mention, bridge alert, and consensus/safety emission sites were a deferred follow-up. AD-1036 wires the **first** live source: a between-turns **@mention** now arouses the mentioned agent for its next turn. The **hard requirement (the Captain's non-disruptive mandate): with `attention.arousal_enabled=False` (default) the agent's `perceive` is BYTE-IDENTICAL to HEAD.**

**Decision.** Architect→Builder, minimal + non-disruptive: **one guarded call inside `CognitiveAgent.perceive`** + a test file. NO config, NO EventType, NO router/registry/bridge/consensus/gossip change.

**Design decisions (DD-1..DD-6).**
- **DD-1 (default-OFF / byte-identical).** The insert is **double-gated**: (1) guarded by `observation.get("params", {}).get("was_mentioned", False)`, AND (2) `on_exogenous_event` itself no-ops unless `attention.enabled` ∧ `arousal_enabled` (both default-OFF). With arousal off (the default) the faculty zone stays GREEN even when `was_mentioned=True` — `perceive` is behaviorally byte-identical (proven by a test with the faculty composed, `was_mentioned=True`, arousal OFF ⇒ GREEN).
- **DD-2 (mention arouses ON).** With `arousal_enabled=True`, an @mentioned turn raises the agent's faculty-local zone to **AMBER** (`_SEVERITY_BY_EVENT["mention"]`, AD-1032) for the next bid competition.
- **DD-3 (not-mentioned no-op).** `arousal_enabled=True` + `was_mentioned=False` ⇒ no arousal (zone stays GREEN).
- **DD-4 (single-fire).** One `perceive` fires **exactly one** `on_exogenous_event("mention")` (proven with a counter on a real `CognitiveAgent` subclass, not a `MagicMock`).
- **DD-5 (non-mention intent).** An intent with no `was_mentioned` param (e.g. a proactive think) ⇒ no arousal.
- **DD-6 (source guard).** `inspect.getsource(perceive)` contains the `was_mentioned`-guarded `on_exogenous_event("mention")` call — the layer-safe shape is pinned against drift.

**Pattern B (the layer-discipline decision — NOT Pattern A).** The agent **self-arouses from its OWN universal `perceive` intake** — the single change is one guarded call inside `CognitiveAgent.perceive`. We did **NOT** make the router/bridge/consensus/gossip call `agent.on_exogenous_event` (Pattern A — a layer violation: mesh/consensus are LOWER layers than cognitive and must not reach up into a cognitive agent). The `was_mentioned` param is already set per-agent at the mesh boundary (`ward_room_router.py`); the agent reads its OWN intake and self-arouses. Sovereignty (AD-397) is preserved: the faculty still never touches the intent bus — it is fed through the agent-owned `spine.deliver_exogenous` inlet.

**Reuses the AD-1032 surface — no new config / EventType.** AD-1036 reuses the EXISTING `attention.arousal_enabled` flag and the EXISTING `_SEVERITY_BY_EVENT` table; it adds **no** config field and **no** `EventType`. No `config/system.yaml` change; no `ui/` change.

**Deferred (documented follow-up AD-1036b).** The remaining live emission sites — bridge alerts, consensus/safety receipts, urgent peer gossip — remain deferred; each is a self-arousal at the receiving agent's own intake (same Pattern B), wired in AD-1036b. AD-1036 ships the @mention pilot ONLY.

**Epic status.** Substantively closes **#985**; with AD-1035 (#984) it completes epic **#983**'s organ-migration work (the AttentionFaculty pilot now has a live exogenous source; the personal DreamingOrgan is composed).

**Files.** EDIT `src/probos/cognitive/cognitive_agent.py` (one guarded insert in `perceive`); NEW `tests/test_ad1036_exogenous_mention.py`. **Tests:** `tests/test_ad1036_exogenous_mention.py` (**8**, BF-287 real `CognitiveAgent` via the AD-1028 golden builder + real `AttentionFaculty` composed on the spine; real `SystemConfig` with `memory.attention.enabled=True` + `arousal_enabled` toggled per test; `asyncio_mode="auto"` plain `async def`): DD-1 default-OFF GREEN-when-off + config-default-OFF; DD-2 mention→AMBER; DD-3 not-mentioned→GREEN; DD-4 single-fire (counter on a real subclass) + zero-when-not-mentioned; DD-5 non-mention intent→GREEN; DD-6 source guard. **Gates:** focused `pytest tests/test_ad1036_exogenous_mention.py tests/test_ad1032_arousal.py tests/test_ad1029_attention_faculty.py -q -n 0` **57 passed** (×2, AD-1032/1029 unchanged byte-identical); import smoke prints **SMOKE OK**; `ast.parse` clean. STAGED (not committed, on top of staged AD-1035). Verify all changes comply with the Engineering Principles in `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

### AD-1035 — DreamingOrgan (personal dreaming faculty) (epic #983)

**Context.** Current highest landed top-level = **AD-1052**; **AD-1035 is a pre-reserved Composable-Cognition sub-number** (epic #983's attention/composition cluster, AD-1029→AD-1036) — it is **NOT a new top-level number**. The second concrete **Cognitive Organ** (AD-1033) after the pilot `AttentionFaculty` (AD-1029): the seam that gives an individual `CognitiveAgent` its *own* offline-consolidation faculty (closes #984), distinct from the ship-wide shared `DreamingEngine` + `DreamScheduler` wired on the runtime. The **hard requirement (the Captain's non-disruptive mandate): with `dreaming.organ_enabled=False` (default) NO organ is composed, the shared engine remains the single source of truth, and the runtime is byte-identical.**

**Decision.** Architect→Builder, contained (a new `cognitive/dreaming_organ.py` + a `_compose_organs` extract-method refactor + one default-OFF config flag + tests).

**Design decisions (DD-1..DD-6).**
- **DD-1 (default-OFF / byte-identical).** New `DreamingConfig.organ_enabled=False`; `_compose_dreaming_organ` early-returns ⇒ no organ attached ⇒ the shared runtime `DreamingEngine` + `DreamScheduler` remain the source of truth (proven: `get_organ("dreaming") is None` when off).
- **DD-2 (composed when ON).** `organ_enabled=True` ⇒ a background `DreamingOrgan` is attached, identity derived + namespaced under the parent (`{parent_id}.dreaming`).
- **DD-3 (wrap, never reimplement — the faithful driver).** With an engine wired, `run_dream_cycle` returns **exactly** `await engine.dream_cycle()` (caching it as `last_report`) — the async, off-the-hot-path analogue of the AD-1029 `arbitrate`==`assemble` guarantee. The organ re-derives NO Hebbian / trust / prune / procedure logic.
- **DD-4 (inert + never raises).** No engine wired (the v1 default) ⇒ `run_dream_cycle` no-ops to `None`; a wired engine that raises is logged-and-degraded to `None` (a dream failure must never crash the owning agent).
- **DD-5 (background organ — OFF the hot path).** `perceive`/`decide`/`act` are the inherited deterministic no-ops, so the spine's per-turn `drive_cycle` NEVER does dream work; the organ's work is the **async** `run_dream_cycle` an out-of-band cadence driver invokes during idle.
- **DD-6 (non-membership).** `DreamingOrgan(BaseCognitiveOrgan)` is **NOT** a `BaseAgent`, NOT registered, NOT mesh-addressable, has no trust score / vote / consensus standing; born with / dies with the parent (`detach_all` releases it).

**The `_compose_organs` extract-method refactor (the trap the Architect caught).** The existing `_compose_organs` had two early returns (attention-already-composed; attention-OFF), so appending a dreaming gate after them would be **unreachable** when attention is OFF. Split into a dispatcher (`_compose_attention_organ()` THEN `_compose_dreaming_organ()`); the existing attention body moved **verbatim** into `_compose_attention_organ` (attention behavior byte-identical — `test_ad1029` unchanged), and the new `_compose_dreaming_organ` carries its own idempotency guard + config gate.

**AD-1035 wires no live engine.** The organ owns no engine in production (the shared background-cognition scheduler that would drive per-agent dreaming on a cadence is a deferred follow-on), so even when `organ_enabled` is True the organ is inert (`run_dream_cycle` no-ops to `None`). No `config/system.yaml` change (default-OFF ships in `config.py`); no `ui/` change.

**Epic status.** Closes #984; #985 (AD-1036) remains before the Composable-Cognition epic #983 closes.

### AD-1032: exogenous interrupts & arousal/zone reconfiguration — faculty-local, default-OFF, byte-identical when OFF (#980, epic #975 / #983)

**Context.** Highest AD heading observed at authoring: **AD-1031** (the prior pilot build; the spine/organ foundation AD-1033/1034 was built first in the phased rollout). **AD-1032 is the number issue #980 carries** — the sixth and final build of the attention pilot, after AD-1028/1029/1030/1031 (`docs/development/attention-architecture.md` §3.5, §4 step 4). On top of AD-1029's `AttentionFaculty` and AD-1031's exogenous-bid path, this gives the faculty a real **arousal model**: an exogenous event (an @mention, a bridge alert, a materially-changed scene, a safety/consensus event, urgent peer gossip) raises a **faculty-local cognitive zone** GREEN→AMBER→RED proportional to severity; arousal **narrows** the bid competition (Yerkes–Dodson attentional narrowing — RED suppresses ambient bids + shrinks the budget, keeping threat-relevant + pinned only); low-severity events **queue** without reconfiguring (cost-of-interruption / ATC alerting hierarchy); the zone **decays** back to GREEN. It is the cognitive-layer mirror of HXI Design Principle #9 (LCARS Red-Alert reconfiguration). The **hard requirement (the Captain's non-disruptive mandate): with `attention.arousal_enabled=False` (default) `arbitrate` is BYTE-IDENTICAL to AD-1029** — and since the faculty is only composed when `attention.enabled` is True, arousal is **double-gated** and doubly inert in production. The policy was Captain-approved (2026-06-19). **Decision.** Architect→Builder, contained + non-disruptive. (1) `AttentionConfig` (config.py) gains `arousal_enabled=False` + `arousal_red_budget_multiplier=0.5` (`gt=0, le=1`) + `arousal_full_decay_seconds=300.0` (`gt=0`) + `arousal_repeat_window_seconds=60.0` (`gt=0`) — all defaulted. (2) `events.py` gains the exogenous-trigger taxonomy `EXOGENOUS_{MENTION,ALERT,SCENE_CHANGE,CONSENSUS,SAFETY,GOSSIP}` — **definitions only**, for the deferred live-wiring follow-up. (3) `attention_faculty.py` — the arousal model, **FACULTY-LOCAL** (REUSES the AD-588 `CognitiveZone`; AMBER is the policy's "YELLOW"; NEVER touches the agent's circuit-breaker / `cognitive_state` zone): module-constant severity table `_SEVERITY_BY_EVENT` (alert/consensus/safety→RED, mention→AMBER, scene_change/gossip→GREEN, keyed on the normalized event_type so the EventType values and the short tags both map) + `_AMBIENT_SOURCES = {"camera_scene_ambient","camera_scene","telemetry","gossip"}` (the real emitted bid sources; `gossip` is forward-looking). State: `_arousal_zone`, `_last_event_at`, `_event_since_last_arbitrate`, `_recent_low_severity`, + an `arousal_zone` introspection property; the faculty binds its parent at `on_attach` and reads `arousal_enabled` (+ the knobs) from the parent's **live** `AttentionConfig` via the agent's existing `_attention_config` resolver (a parent without it ⇒ arousal bypassed). `on_signal` EXTENDED: an arousal **event** (a Mapping carrying `event_type`) raises the zone UPWARD only (max-by-rank; RED immediately; AMBER from a mention; scene_change/gossip GREEN unless the same low-severity type repeats within the window ⇒ AMBER) and enqueues a **pinned** threat-relevant bid so the event content survives RED narrowing — but ONLY when `arousal_enabled`; OFF ⇒ the event is dropped (nothing pending) ⇒ byte-identical; NON-event payloads take the unchanged AD-1029 coerce-to-bid path. `decide` (before assembling, gated by `arousal_enabled`): DECAY (a quiet turn steps the zone down one level; a quiet period > `arousal_full_decay_seconds` resets to GREEN; an event turn does not decay) then NARROW (GREEN→no change; AMBER→drop `camera_scene_ambient`; RED→drop `_AMBIENT_SOURCES` + multiply the budget; **pin=True never dropped**). `act` adds `arousal_zone` to the audit trace (non-breaking — the AD-1029 audit tests assert specific keys only). (4) `cognitive_agent.py` — the single **governed boundary** (sovereignty / AD-397): `on_exogenous_event(event_type, *, severity=None, **payload)` forwards to `self._spine.deliver_exogenous({...})` when `arousal_enabled` + the faculty exists, else a safe no-op — the documented hook a future AD wires real sources to. **DEFERRED (HARD scope cut):** the live mesh emission-site wiring (making real router @mentions / bridge alerts / consensus/safety events actually call the boundary) — those sources live in separate subsystems (router/bridge/consensus) with no clean per-agent inbound hook; every issue acceptance criterion is satisfiable through the governed boundary, so this AD did NOT touch runtime/router/bridge/consensus emission sites. **Byte-identical proof (multi-level):** `attention.enabled=False` ⇒ no faculty ⇒ inline `ContextAssembler` path; `enabled=True` + `arousal_enabled=False` ⇒ faculty active but arousal fully bypassed ⇒ `arbitrate` == AD-1029; `arousal_enabled=True` + GREEN/no-event ⇒ no narrowing — all proven by the AD-1029 suite + AD-1028 goldens passing UNCHANGED (gate: ad1032 + ad1029 + ad1028 + ad1031 = **82 passed**). **Tests:** `tests/test_ad1032_arousal.py` (25, BF-287 real `AttentionFaculty` + real `CognitiveSpine` + real `SystemConfig`/`AttentionConfig` + real `CognitiveAgent` for the boundary): severity table + upward-only raise; RED drops ambient + budget multiplier + keeps pinned event bid & non-ambient core; AMBER drops only `camera_scene_ambient`; single scene_change queues (GREEN, no narrowing) / repeat→AMBER; pinned never dropped under RED; decay step-down + full-reset; OFF byte-identical even with an event delivered; governed boundary forwards-when-ON / no-op-when-OFF; AST proof of no `await`/no bus on the arousal path. Blast-radius `test_distribution.py` + `test_hxi_chat_integration.py` = **38 passed**; `import probos.runtime` smoke ok. **Scope:** NO circuit-breaker/`cognitive_state` zone write (AD-588 byte-identical); NO live emission-site wiring (deferred follow-up); NO HXI/UI; NO `arbitrate`/`assemble`/`AttentionBid`/organ/spine contract change; NO `config/system.yaml` change. Staged for review, not committed.

### AD-1031: camera / visual scene as a salience-gated bid — default-OFF, byte-identical when OFF (#979, closes #973, fixes the BF-632 class, epic #975 / #983)

**Context.** Highest AD heading observed at authoring: **AD-1034** (the epic's spine/organ foundation, built first in the phased rollout); **AD-1031 is the number issue #979 carries** — the fifth build of the attention pilot, after AD-1028/1029/1030; AD-1032 remains unbuilt (`docs/development/attention-architecture.md` §4). Today the AD-733a visual-context block is **unconditionally prepended** to every 1:1 DM in the router (`routers/agents.py`), so it dominates the prompt, makes agents over-narrate the scene (#973), and was the upstream cause of BF-632 (it even hijacked the recall query). The scene should win prompt space only when it is **salient**. The **hard requirement (the Captain's non-disruptive mandate): with `camera_scene_bid_enabled=False` (default) the AD-733a router prepend runs EXACTLY as today and the agent emits no camera bid — byte-identical.** The salience policy was Captain-approved (2026-06-19). **Decision.** Architect→Builder. A **two-site, one-flag** change. (1) `AttentionConfig` (config.py) gains `camera_scene_bid_enabled=False` + `camera_novelty_minimum=0.3` (`ge=0, le=1`) — default-OFF. (2) New pure helper `visual_reference_score(text) -> float` in `cognitive/salience.py`: `1.0` iff the text references vision (a two-layer keyword/phrase detector — multi-word phrases as substrings, single words on word boundaries via tokenization so `"seem"`/`"overlook"` do NOT false-match), else `0.0`; no I/O, fully unit-tested. (3) `routers/agents.py` (the AD-733a block): when the flag is **ON**, do NOT prepend `_scene_block` onto `message_text` — instead hand it to the agent via `params["_visual_scene"]` + `_visual_novelty` (`_wm.latest().novelty_score`) + `_visual_summary` (`latest().description`); when **OFF** (default), the existing `message_text = f"{_scene_block}\n\n{message_text}"` prepend runs unchanged (byte-identical). `force_describe` + `note_dm_activity` run in BOTH cases (side effects, not prompt content). `captain_message` stays RAW (BF-632). (4) `cognitive_agent.py` DM branch of `_build_user_message`: when ON and `params["_visual_scene"]` is present, compute `prominent = referenced OR changed OR visual_task` where `referenced = visual_reference_score(params["captain_message"]) > 0` (RAW — BF-632, NEVER the merged `text`), `changed = _visual_novelty >= camera_novelty_minimum`, `visual_task = has_image_attachment`. If `prominent` OR the WM is empty (no `_visual_summary` → the BF-294 confabulation sentinel, which MUST always show): emit the FULL scene as a `camera_scene` bid with **PRIMACY** (`zone_floor=-1_000_000` leads + a very high salience that always survives a scarce budget) — approximating the old prepend's primacy + always-present guarantee. Else: emit a **RECESSIVE** `camera_scene_ambient` one-line `[Live camera] {summary}` bid (`zone_floor=+1_000_000` trails + salience `-1.0` so it is the first unpinned bid dropped under scarcity) — present-but-quiet, provenance-distinct from memory. OFF / no `_visual_scene` ⇒ emits NOTHING. The DM `_emit` closure gains an optional `zone_floor` kwarg (None→idx, byte-identical; the WR `_emit` is untouched). The bid flows through whichever path is active — `ContextAssembler.assemble` when attention is OFF (the production reality: perception ON / attention OFF) or `AttentionFaculty.arbitrate` when ON — **NOT** the spine `deliver_exogenous` inlet (that's AD-1032). **Byte-identical proof:** the AD-1028 DM golden + the AD-733a router-prepend tests stay green UNCHANGED. **Tests:** `test_ad1031_camera_bid.py` (14, BF-287 real objects — real `CognitiveAgent`, real `SystemConfig`, real `VisionObservation`/`VisionWorkingMemory`); gate (ad1031 + ad1028 + ad733a) = **59 passed**; blast-radius (test_distribution + test_hxi_chat_integration) = **38 passed**; `import probos.runtime` smoke ok. **Scope:** NO new vision-tier LLM call (reuse `novelty_score`); NO engagement-adaptive cadence (follow-up AD); NO faculty exogenous/`deliver_exogenous` path (AD-1032); WR branch untouched; `config/system.yaml` untouched. Staged for review, not committed.

### AD-1030: salience scoring (relevance × recency × importance) for episodic + working-memory bids (#978, epic #975 / #983)

**Context.** Highest AD heading observed at authoring: **AD-1034** (the epic built the spine/organ foundation AD-1033/1034 first, then AD-1028/1029; **AD-1030 is the number the issue #978 carries**, and AD-1031/1032 remain unbuilt in the phased rollout — `docs/development/attention-architecture.md` §6). On top of AD-1028's `AttentionBid`/`ContextAssembler` and AD-1029's `AttentionFaculty`, this makes the faculty actually **adaptive**: the fixed insertion priority for the two biggest, most-variable context sources — **episodic recall** and **working memory** — is replaced by a transparent **linear salience** so memories are selected/ordered by how much they matter to the current goal (the raw Captain message — the BF-632 lesson). The **hard requirement (the Captain's non-disruptive mandate): with `attention.salience_scoring=False` (default) the AD-1029 fixed-priority path is byte-identical** — and since `attention.enabled` is also default-OFF the feature is doubly inert in production. **Decision.** Architect→Builder. (1) New pure module `src/probos/cognitive/salience.py`: `compute_salience(*, relevance, recency, importance, weights) -> float` = the weight-normalized linear sum `(w_rel·rel + w_rec·rec + w_imp·imp_norm)/Σw` over normalized `[0,1]` terms (so the result stays in `[0,1]` and the absolute weight scale is free); helpers `recency_decay(age_seconds, half_life) = exp(-age/half_life)` (an e-folding decay, `age≤0`/`half_life≤0` → `1.0`), `importance_norm = clamp((importance-1)/9)` for the AD-598 1–10 scale, and a pure `cosine_similarity(vec_a, vec_b)` (the relevance term; mirrors two pre-existing private copies — consolidation deferred). **No I/O, no embedding model, no clock — fully unit-testable; no `await`.** (2) `AttentionConfig` (config.py) gains `salience_scoring=False` + weights `w_rel=1.0`/`w_rec=0.5`/`w_imp=0.5` + `recency_half_life_seconds=86400.0` — all defaulted, scoring **independent of** the `enabled` budget gate. (3) The single recall write-site (`cognitive_agent.py` `observation["recent_memories"]`) is enriched with internal `_embedding`/`_timestamp`/`_importance` keys **only when `salience_scoring` is ON** (underscore = never rendered by `_format_memory_section`); OFF adds no keys ⇒ byte-identical recall payload. (4) `_build_user_message` DM + WR branches, **gated behind `salience_scoring`**: embed the goal ONCE (`embed_text(captain/author text)`); for the **episodic** bid, score each memory (`cosine` relevance · `recency_decay` · AD-598 importance), reorder the block by salience DESC (so a high-relevance low-recency memory can outrank a low-relevance recent one) and set the bid's `salience = max(per-memory)`; for the **working-memory** bid, score `max` over entries (relevance + recency, **importance omitted via `w_imp=0`** — WM entries carry no importance signal) and set the bid salience. Other bids keep fixed priority. New `_salience_scoring_enabled()`/`_salience_weights()`/`_salience_half_life()`/`_salience_rank_memories()`/`_salience_score_wm_bid()` helpers + a new public `AgentWorkingMemory.iter_salience_entries()` snapshot accessor (respects encapsulation). `AttentionManager.score_bid` stays the identity over the bid's (now possibly scored) salience — the formula lives in `salience.py`, applied at the bid-build where the per-memory data is in scope; the task-scoring `_compute_single` is untouched. **Spreading activation (AD-604) is DEFERRED** — issue #978 lists it as a relevance contributor, but that engine is **asynchronous and dormant** and belongs in the (async) recall path, NOT this **synchronous** salience scorer; wiring it in would force an `await` onto the faculty's hot path (violates the AD-1033/§9 "no await on the cycle" rule). It is a follow-up; AD-1030 ships the pure three-term scorer only. **HARD-STOP guard (c) — working memory ships bid-salience-only:** `AgentWorkingMemory.render_context` is a category-grouped, priority-sorted, budget-evicted render with **no flat per-entry ordered path**, so reordering WM entries by salience would require an invasive `render_context` rewrite — out of scope; WM therefore gets a scored **bid salience** (its competition weight) but **no internal reorder** (its content is unchanged). **Scale caveat:** when scoring is ON the episodic/WM bids carry `[0,1]` salience while other bids keep idx-based salience; this only affects **selection** when `attention.enabled` is ALSO ON (a tight budget) — under the default unbounded budget the only visible effect is the intra-episodic-block reorder. Unifying the salience scale across all bid sources is AD-1033 (cross-source budget reallocation). **Byte-identical (the hard requirement):** the AD-1028 golden DM/WR suite + the AD-1029 suite pass UNCHANGED (gate: AD-1030 + AD-1029 + AD-1028 = 70 passed). Tests: `test_ad1030_salience.py` (27, BF-287 real `embed_text` embeddings on the relevance path incl. the default-weights rank-flip + the weight-driven flip, recency/importance/cosine term tests, ON-reorders/OFF-preserves-recall-order via `_build_user_message`, render-safety of the internal keys, WM bid-salience-only); blast-radius `test_distribution.py` + `test_hxi_chat_integration.py` = 38 passed; `import probos.runtime` smoke ok. Scope: NO spreading activation (deferred), NO camera gating (AD-1031), NO arousal/zone (AD-1032), NO learned scorer, NO WM internal reorder, NO `config/system.yaml` change. Staged for review, not committed.

### AD-1029: the `AttentionFaculty` — per-agent deterministic paired attention organ (#977, epic #975 / #983)

**Context.** Highest AD heading observed at authoring: **AD-1034**. The pilot **Cognitive Organ** of the Composable-Cognition / Attention epic (`docs/development/attention-architecture.md` §3, §4), on top of AD-1033's `CognitiveOrgan` contract, AD-1034's `CognitiveSpine`, and AD-1028's `AttentionBid`/`ContextAssembler`/`AttentionConfig`. It is the answer to "could the controller be a deterministic agent each cognitive agent is paired with?" — **yes, as a paired cognitive organ, not a mesh peer.** The **hard requirement (the Captain's non-disruptive mandate): with `memory.attention.enabled=False` (default) the faculty is NOT constructed, so `_spine.has_organs` stays False, `drive_cycle` stays a no-op, and `_build_user_message` keeps the exact AD-1028 inline path — byte-identical.** **Decision.** Architect→Builder. (1) New `src/probos/cognitive/attention_faculty.py`: `AttentionFaculty(BaseCognitiveOrgan)`, `default_name="attention"` (organ_id `{parent_id}.attention`) — **deterministic, synchronous, NO LLM, NO bus round-trip on the hot path**. Cycle: `perceive` drains pending **exogenous** bids and merges them with the per-turn bids; `decide` delegates selection/ordering to the pure `ContextAssembler.assemble` under the global token budget (v1 salience = the bid's existing **fixed insertion priority** — NO salience scoring, that is AD-1030); `act` writes a **bid-competition audit trace** (bids_in / survivors / dropped / budget / used_tokens / sources) — a pure SIDE-EFFECT that never changes the prompt. The synchronous entry point `arbitrate(bids, *, token_budget) -> list[str]` runs `perceive→decide→act` and, **with no pending exogenous and v1 fixed salience, returns EXACTLY `ContextAssembler.assemble(bids, token_budget=…)` — the byte-identical "faithful driver" guarantee.** The cycle is polymorphic so the spine's generic `drive_cycle(observation)` is a deterministic no-op (no drain, no assemble, no audit) — exogenous is drained ONCE, at `arbitrate` time, so a between-turn signal stays visible to the NEXT turn. (2) **Exogenous intake**: `on_signal(EXOGENOUS_SIGNAL_KIND, payload)` coerces a mesh-sourced signal (delivered between turns through the agent-owned `spine.deliver_exogenous` inlet — NOT the real intent bus, that is AD-1032) into a pending `AttentionBid`. (3) **Audit sink**: the cognitive journal (AD-431) `record` is async + LLM-shaped, so per the AD-1033 organ-audit decoupling the trace routes through the sync `OrganAuditEmit` seam (the agent wires `_emit_attention_audit`, a structured debug-log sink — **NOT a new persistence layer**). (4) **Minimal `CognitiveAgent` wiring**: `_compose_organs` (was a no-op) composes the faculty **only when `memory.attention.enabled` is True** (same resolution `_resolve_attention_budget` uses), wiring `set_audit_emit` + `attach_organ` + `subscribe(EXOGENOUS_SIGNAL_KIND)` (idempotent); a tiny `_active_attention_faculty()` accessor (`spine.get_organ("attention")`, guard None); and the DM + WR `_build_user_message` returns branch to `faculty.arbitrate(…)` when a faculty is composed, ELSE the **textually-unchanged** AD-1028 `ContextAssembler.assemble(…)` line. **Paired-faculty classification** (new): the `AttentionFaculty` is a **paired cognitive organ** — 1:1 with its agent, intrinsic, deterministic, meta-cognitive **child component** (born with / dies with the parent, identity namespaced under it) — **not** a mesh peer (no registry entry, no mesh address, no trust score / vote / consensus standing; structurally not a `BaseAgent`). **Deliberately deferred** (so v1 is provably behavior-preserving): real salience math (AD-1030), camera/visual-scene gating (AD-1031), arousal/zone reconfiguration + real intent-bus wiring (AD-1032). **Tests:** `tests/test_ad1029_attention_faculty.py` (24 tests, BF-287 real `AttentionFaculty` + real `CognitiveSpine`): default-OFF no-faculty; `arbitrate` == `assemble` (unbounded + tight budget); `_build_user_message` ON == OFF byte-identical (DM + WR); `_compose_organs` enabled-gated attach/subscribe/idempotent; exogenous visible-then-drained-once; `drive_cycle` no-op (no drain / no audit); audit recorded + prompt unchanged; AST proof of no `await`/no bus on the sync path; organ_id namespaced + not a mesh agent. AD-1028 goldens (`dm/wr_golden.txt`) pass **unchanged** (the default-OFF byte-identical proof). Blast-radius `test_distribution.py` + `test_hxi_chat_integration.py` green; `import probos.runtime` clean.

### AD-1028: ContextAssembler seam + `AttentionBid` + global token budget — behavior-preserving (#976, epic #975 / #983)

**Context.** Third and final build of the Composable-Cognition / Attention foundation (`docs/development/attention-architecture.md` §4, §6), on top of AD-1033's `CognitiveOrgan` contract and AD-1034's `CognitiveSpine`. Today the DM and Ward-Room prompts are assembled **push-style** — each source prepends into a fixed ~14-step chain with no arbiter and **no global token budget** (a busy DM can silently overflow the model window). This AD introduces the **pull-style seam**: every context block becomes an `AttentionBid` and a pure `ContextAssembler` selects/orders the winners under a budget. The **hard requirement (the Captain's non-disruptive mandate): with `attention.enabled=False` (default) the DM and WR prompt is byte-identical to today.** **Decision.** Architect→Builder. (1) New `AttentionBid{source, render (LAZY zero-arg renderer), modality, salience, token_cost, zone_floor, pin}` dataclass + `estimate_tokens(text)` (~4 chars/token) + a pure `ContextAssembler.assemble(bids, *, token_budget) -> list[str]` (staticmethod; pinned always kept; non-pinned admitted highest-salience-first while the running total stays within budget — scarcity drops the LOWEST-salience unpinned bid, never blind truncation; survivors ordered by `(zone_floor, insertion_order)` for primacy/recency; `render()` is called ONLY on survivors, so a dropped bid's renderer is never invoked) — all in `cognitive/attention.py` alongside the repurposed `AttentionManager`. (2) `AttentionManager` gains a `score_bid`/`score_bids` seam (v1 returns the bid's fixed salience — behavior-preserving; the task-scoring API is untouched; AD-1030 plugs the real `relevance × recency × importance` formula in here). (3) New `AttentionConfig{enabled=False, token_budget=120_000}` nested at `MemoryConfig.attention` (every field defaulted → runs out-of-the-box). (4) `CognitiveAgent._build_user_message` DM + WR branches refactored: each existing block becomes an `AttentionBid` whose LAZY renderer returns EXACTLY the segment(s) it previously appended (the DM trailing-`""` and WR leading-`""` separator conventions reproduced inside each bid), routed through `ContextAssembler.assemble(...)`. Budget resolves via the new `_resolve_attention_budget()` — flag-OFF → an effectively-unbounded `1_000_000_000` so nothing drops (byte-identical); flag-ON → the configured `token_budget` (the first global overflow guard). All async/side-effecting blocks (telemetry snapshot caching, sensorium dispatch, DM self-monitoring) keep their awaits + side effects at collect time, exactly as before. **Byte-identity is the paramount constraint** — proven by two golden snapshots captured from the unmodified method (`tests/fixtures/ad1028_golden/{dm,wr}_golden.txt`, reused by the regression tests via the shared `_capture_golden.py` builders) that the refactored method reproduces with the flag off. The `_build_user_message` signature (`async def ...(self, observation: dict) -> str`) and the subclass override contract (`architect.py`, `builder.py` delegate via `super()`) are unchanged; the non-DM/WR paths (chain, `proactive_think`, fallback) are untouched. Defers salience scoring (AD-1030), camera gating (AD-1031), exogenous interrupts (AD-1032), and the `AttentionFaculty` organ (AD-1029). **Tests:** new `tests/test_ad1028_context_assembler.py` — 2 golden byte-identity (DM + WR) + 6 assembler (select/order/budget/empty/pin/lazy) + 3 config + 2 manager-seam + 1 task-scoring-unchanged + 2 budget-gating + 3 estimate-tokens/identity = 19 passed; blast-radius `tests/test_distribution.py tests/test_hxi_chat_integration.py` 38 passed unchanged; sensorium/comm regression `test_ad723_sensorium_dispatch + test_ad666_sensorium + test_ad649_communication_context` 53 passed; `import probos.runtime` OK. Verify all changes comply with the Engineering Principles in `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

### AD-1034: the `CognitiveSpine` (thin) — the agent's synchronous central nervous system, behavior-preserving (#982, epic #975 / #983)

**Context.** Second build of the Composable-Cognition foundation (Design Principle #12; `docs/development/composable-cognition.md` §2.2–§2.5, §9), on top of AD-1033's `CognitiveOrgan` contract. `CognitiveAgent._run_cognitive_lifecycle` is already the *proto-spine* (it drives `perceive→decide→act` and calls the faculties); this AD **names and formalizes** that backbone as an owned object **without changing agent behavior**. The **hard requirement:** with **zero organs registered (the default for every existing agent), the running system is byte-identical to today.** **Decision.** Architect→Builder. New standalone `src/probos/cognitive/spine.py`: a `CognitiveSpine`, owned by a `CognitiveAgent` (`self._spine = CognitiveSpine(self)` in `__init__`), doing four things — (1) **Composition**: an insertion-ordered name→organ registry (`attach_organ` calls `organ.attach(parent)`; `detach_organ`/`detach_all` call `organ.detach()`; `organs`/`organ_names`/`has_organs`/`get_organ`/`parent_id`/`last_exogenous` introspection; a duplicate-name attach is refused log-and-degrade so identity stays 1:1). (2) **Cycle**: `drive_cycle(context)` runs `perceive→decide→act` across organs **in attach order, synchronously** — **zero organs returns immediately** (the byte-identical fast path); each organ is isolated log-and-degrade. (3) **Signaling**: a synchronous in-process observer channel (`subscribe(kind, organ)` + `emit_signal(kind, payload)`) — **not** the intent bus; an organ receives via an opt-in `on_signal(kind, payload)` *spine convention* deliberately **not** added to the AD-1033 organ protocol; subscribing without a handler is refused (fail-fast). (4) **Governed inlet**: `deliver_exogenous(signal)` — the single agent-owned mesh boundary (sovereignty / AD-397); AD-1034 **STUBS** it (stores `last_exogenous` + forwards on the in-process channel under `EXOGENOUS_SIGNAL_KIND`); wiring it to the real intent bus is AD-1031/1032. **Minimal `CognitiveAgent` wiring:** construct `self._spine` in `__init__`; a `_compose_organs()` birth hook (no-op default — organs born with the parent) and a `stop()` override calling `detach_all()` (organs die with the parent); a **GUARDED hook** in `_run_cognitive_lifecycle` between `_recall_relevant_memories` and `decide` that calls `drive_cycle` **only if `self._spine.has_organs`** — so with zero organs it never fires (byte-identical). **PERF/discipline (§9):** the cycle path is SYNCHRONOUS — no `await` on a bus/network call (asserted via an `ast.Await`-node walk + `iscoroutinefunction`). **Sovereignty:** the spine imports/holds no intent-bus reference (asserted via source + held-state inspection); organs reach the mesh only via `deliver_exogenous`. Scope: NO concrete organ (AD-1029), NO real-bus wiring (AD-1031/1032), NO mesh-peer registration, NO async/networked spine, NO `config/system.yaml` change. Highest AD heading observed before this entry: **AD-1033**. Tests: `test_ad1034_cognitive_spine.py` (29, BF-287 real `CognitiveSpine` + real `_FakeOrgan(BaseCognitiveOrgan)` + a minimal real `CognitiveAgent`); gate 29 passed. **Byte-identical proof:** the existing real-agent lifecycle / `handle_intent` / `direct_message` / `stop` suites stay green unchanged — `test_distribution` + `test_hxi_chat_integration` + `test_ad398_crew_identity` + `test_ad492_cognitive_correlation_ids` + `test_ad568e_faithfulness_verification` + `test_ad585_tiered_knowledge` = 153 passed; `import probos.runtime` smoke ok. Staged for review, not committed.

### AD-1033: the `CognitiveOrgan` contract — a child component of an agent, not a mesh agent (#981, epic #975 / #983)

**Context.** The Composable-Cognition foundation (Design Principle #12; `docs/development/composable-cognition.md` §2.1, §7) needs a *contract* before any organ or spine exists: what IS a cognitive organ, in code? An organ is a bounded faculty (attention, memory, valuation, perception-gating) a `CognitiveAgent` is *composed of* — a **child component, NOT a mesh agent**: no registry entry, no mesh address, no trust score / vote / consensus standing; born with the parent, dies with the parent; identity *derived* and namespaced under the parent (`{parent_id}.{name}`). Prerequisite for AD-1029 (`AttentionFaculty`, the first organ) and AD-1034 (the spine). **Decision.** Architect→Builder. Ship the **contract only** — a new standalone `src/probos/cognitive/organ.py`. (1) A `@runtime_checkable typing.Protocol` `CognitiveOrgan` capturing the five-part test (§2.1): the **synchronous** `perceive → decide → act` cycle (deterministic-by-default — §9's "no `await` on the cycle path"; intentionally distinct from `BaseAgent`'s *async* mesh lifecycle — the different-scale spine-vs-mesh point, NOT a `CognitiveAgent` contract change), parent-bound idempotent `attach(parent)`/`detach()`, identity properties (`name`/`organ_id`/`parent_id`/`attached`), and a thin `set_audit_emit(emit)` injection point. (2) `make_organ_id(parent_id, name) -> f"{parent_id}.{name}"` — the pure child-identity helper. (3) `BaseCognitiveOrgan` — a minimal concrete base (**NOT** a `BaseAgent` subclass — that absence IS the structural proof of non-membership) storing `parent_id`+`name`, exposing `organ_id`, with idempotent `attach`/`detach` (+ `on_attach`/`on_detach` subclass hooks), a deterministic no-op default cycle, and an `_emit_audit_trace` helper. (4) The **audit hook is decoupled from the cognitive journal (AD-431)**: the journal's `record` is async but the organ cycle is sync, so the sink is a sync `OrganAuditEmit = Callable[[Mapping[str, Any]], None]` defaulting to a no-op (the spine, AD-1034, adapts it to the journal off the hot path). **Byte-identical:** the module imports nothing from `probos` and nothing imports it — it constructs no organ, drives no cycle, and wires into no agent/registry/mesh/spawner (a test asserts the module source is `probos`-import-free; the `import probos.runtime` smoke still boots). Identity prefers the AD-441 `sovereign_id`, falling back to the runtime `id`. Scope: NO spine (AD-1034), NO concrete organ (AD-1029), NO registry/mesh/`CognitiveAgent` change. Tests: `test_ad1033_cognitive_organ_protocol.py` (27, BF-287 real `_FakeOrgan`/`_FakeParent` — no MagicMock): runtime_checkable conformance (+ a plain object rejected), `make_organ_id`, organ_id stability across attach→cycle→detach, attach/detach idempotency + state tracking, AD-441 sovereign-id preference, sync-cycle guard (`iscoroutinefunction` False), audit default-noop/settable/failure-swallowed/None-restores-noop, name-required, and the non-membership structural assert (not a `BaseAgent`; no `tier`/`trust_score`/`capabilities`/`report`/`start`/`stop`). Gate: 27 passed + import smoke `ok`. Staged for review, not committed.

### BF-632: drive 1:1 DM episodic recall off the RAW Captain message, not the router-assembled prompt text (#974)

**Context.** THE root cause of the dogs never surfacing — found via the BF-631 DM-recall diagnostic on the live runtime, which logged the actual recall query as `q='--- Current Visual Context ---\nMost recent observation (14h ...'` for EVERY 1:1 DM (agent d00cb0bd = Yeo). The HXI router (`routers/agents.py:agent_chat`) PREPENDS the visual-context block (AD-733a, Wave 171), project preamble (AD-793), and targeted-recall block (AD-725) onto `message_text` so the receiving agent's LLM sees them as part of the user turn. `_recall_relevant_memories` then used `params["text"][:200]` as the episodic recall query — which, post-prepend, is the *visual scene description*, not what the Captain asked. So every 1:1 recall searched for the room and returned the agent's own visual reflections, never the Captain's words. This is why BF-630 (keyword axis) and BF-631 (query-echo filter) — both genuine recall fixes — could not surface the dogs: the QUERY was wrong upstream, and the offline reproductions used the clean query so they never reproduced the live failure. Offline proof against the live store: with the contaminated visual query `ANSWER_PRESENT=False` (returns scene/group reflections); with the raw "What do you know about my dogs?" `ANSWER_PRESENT=True` (the dog episodes surface). **Decision.** Builder. The router threads the raw `req.message` through as a new `params["captain_message"]` (set BEFORE the visual/project/recall prepends mutate `message_text`). New pure `_dm_recall_query(params) -> str` returns `(params["captain_message"] or params["text"])[:200].strip()` — preferring the raw message, falling back to `text` for callers that don't set it (work-item dispatch, where `text` is already the raw task). `_recall_relevant_memories` calls it for the `direct_message` query. `params["text"]` is UNCHANGED (the LLM still sees the full assembled prompt incl. the visual block); only the RECALL QUERY changes. The three fixes compose: BF-632 supplies the correct query, BF-630 makes the keyword axis fire on it, BF-631 strips the question-echoes so the answer leads. **Tests.** `test_bf632_dm_recall_query.py` (6): prefers captain_message over prepended text, falls back to text without it, the contaminated-text-alone bug demonstration, truncate-then-strip, empty captain_message fallback, empty params.
